desc: Derive the binary-mask formulation: after a fixed column-flip mask, each row is independently flipped or not to contribute \(\min(\mathrm{popcount}(a\oplus c), W-\mathrm{popcount}(a\oplus c))\).
Implement frequency and radial-cost arrays and compute all column-mask scores via normalized XOR Walsh-Hadamard convolution in \(O(W2^W+H)\).
Run and verify all provided sample cases using the implementation.
Check edge cases such as \(H=1\), \(W=1\), all-zero rows, and all-one rows.
